title: HELIX Terminology: First-Destination Status
description: NACE-aligned first-destination career outcome categories for graduates. Used by EmploymentOutcome and FirstDestinationSurvey resources. Aligned with the NACE First-Destination Survey Standards and Protocols.

codes.definition: Working in a full-time paid position (typically 30+ hours/week)
Working in a part-time paid position
Enrolled in a program of continuing/further education
Participating in a volunteer or service program (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps)
Actively seeking employment, not yet employed
Actively seeking to enroll in further education
Not seeking employment or continuing education (by choice)
Working in a self-owned business or practice
Engaged in freelance or contract work
Participating in a postgraduate fellowship or internship
Outcome unknown; no reasonable and verifiable information available (excluded from knowledge rate)

notes: Aligned with NACE First-Destination Survey Standards. The 'knowledge rate' is the percentage of graduates for whom the institution has reasonable and verifiable outcome information (all statuses except 'unknown').
